name: invoice_status
title: Invoice status
description: Look up a supplier's invoice by the number printed on it (e.g. 4471), optionally narrowed by supplier name. Returns Bahi's own document number (AP/...), status, hold code and due date. Two suppliers can use the same invoice number: if more than one matches, ask which.

invoice_no.description: the number on the supplier's invoice, e.g. 4471

invoices.description: ap_no, supplier, invoice_no, invoice_date, gross, status, hold_code, due_date

next_step.description: what to do next, when there is something to ask
